newsitem.title: GREECE: TWA TO END NEW YORK-ATHENS/FRANKFURT SERVICE - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: TWA TO END NEW YORK-ATHENS/FRANKFURT SERVICE - PAPER.

text.p: Trans World Airlines (TWA) plans to eliminate two of its international flights connecting New York with the European cities of Athens and Frankfurt, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
TWA, which is the smallest of big U.S. carriers, has twice gone through Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection as per U.S. law.
In the quarter to September of this year it had to report a 43.2 percent decline in profits, after the tragic mid-air accident of its New York-Paris flight.
The company has tried to recover but has found it very diffult to regain its financial strength, the Financial Times said. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
